description: Replays a chain in the chain format over the past days without saving it: how often it would have fired. Checked like an import first; errors come back with their place in the JSON. Use it before create_chain, or before update_chain with a definition.

days.description: How many days the replay looks back; default 90, at most replayDays from get_account.

definition.description: A chain in the Bellchain chain format (https://docs.bellchain.app/en/developers/chain-format/): nodes with id, type and settings, edges from output to input pins. Actions such as core.telegram fire when their input turns true at a candle close.

customNodes.description: Own nodes with formulas, as in the chain format docs.

edges.description: Connections from an output to an input of the same pin type; each input takes one. Growing inputs such as AND are in0, in1 …

from.description: Output pin as node.pin, such as c1.close.

to.description: Input pin as node.pin, such as r1.in.

name.description: Name of the chain; messages show it as {{kette}}.

id.description: Unique in the chain, starts with a letter, no dot, such as c1 or rsi1.

position.description: Place on the board; leave it out and Bellchain arranges the nodes.

settings.description: Settings by name; missing ones take their default (get_node).

type.description: Node type such as "core.rsi", from list_nodes.

pauseAfterAlert.description: Pause the chain after its first alert.

scanner.description: Scanner: the candle "node" runs once per coin, for a list (pairs, such as ["ETH/USDT"]) or the top N by volume (top: {"count": 20, "quote": "USDT"}).

trade.description: Take-profit and stop-loss for scoring the signals as trades: entry at the close of the alert candle, a candle reaching both counts as SL, every signal on its own. Default: the chain’s or template’s values (meta.trade), otherwise TP and SL 2 : 1 fitting the timeframe, such as 3 % and 1.5 % on hourly candles.

breakEven.description: With stages: after the first TP stage the SL moves to the entry.

fee.description: Fee per side in percent, default 0.1.

maxBars.description: Exit at the close of this many candles after the entry if neither TP nor SL came by then.

side.description: long profits when the price rises, short when it falls.

stages.description: Up to two more TP stages after takeProfit (TP2, TP3), each further away; every stage closes an equal part of the trade.

stopLoss.description: Stop-loss (SL) in percent from the entry, such as 1.5; with unit "atr" as a multiple of the ATR.

takeProfit.description: Take-profit (TP) in percent from the entry, such as 3; with unit "atr" as a multiple of the ATR, such as 2.

trailing.description: Trailing stop: the SL follows the best price since the entry at the stopLoss distance.

unit.description: percent (default) or atr: TP and SL as multiples of the ATR 14 at the alert candle.
